data.exact_reserve_text: Loss experience for the 2015 pure year was better than expectation, with a net (gross of commissions) ultimate loss ratio of 55.8% against a plan of 59.2%, producing a 2015 pure year underwriting profit (before expenses) of GBP 83,261k. The 2014 and prior years produced a net loss of GBP 10,679k, following worse than expected claims activity, particularly in Professional Indemnity.

prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2016 net underwriting profit included the anticipated impact of the announcement from the Ministry of Justice, reducing the statutory discount rate applied to certain UK personal injury claims (referred to as Ogden tables) to -0.75%. The UK government's subsequent decision to revise its proposals for the Ogden discount rate to an expected range of between 0% and 1%, has been reflected in the 2017 result at an assumed rate of +0.25%. This had an improved impact on the combined operating ratio.
The 2014 and prior years produced a net loss of GBP 10,679k, following worse than expected claims activity, particularly in Professional Indemnity.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced mixed prior year development in 2017. The 2015 underwriting year closed with a net profit of GBP 83.261 million, indicating favorable claims development better than expectation across International Casualty, UK and Ireland Liability, and Professional Lines. However, the 2014 and prior years of account incurred a net loss of GBP 10.679 million due to worse than expected claims activity, particularly in Professional Indemnity. Overall, the syndicate reported an improved combined operating ratio partly due to the improved impact of Ogden table changes and claims inflation assumptions on UK Employer's Liability reserves, despite adverse large loss experience in Professional Lines.
raw_causal_phrases: improved impact of the Ogden table changes
claims inflation assumptions on UK Employer's Liability reserves
adverse large loss experience in the Professional Lines portfolio
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount is net of reinsurance as gross figure was not explicitly stated in the report. The net figure is derived from the sum of the 2015 year of account closure profit and the 2014 and prior years of account closure loss.
